text:
marta: Heads-up — aggregate p99 for /v1/embeddings jumps to ~1.1s at 08:22 but the endpoint split p99 is ~260ms. anyone else seeing a large delta?
sam: Saw that spike in traces. My hunch: origin mix (proxy/edge + backend) or retries counted in the aggregate.
lee: Reminder: we flipped endpoint tiles last month to default to 'server' origin only; aggregate views still merge all origins. That will cause divergence when fallback/proxy traffic is slow.
marta: Console gives no hint about provenance on the percentile row so oncall thought backend regressed. UX is misleading.
lee: Proposal: add a compact origin badge next to each percentile (p50/p95/p99) and on-hover show a tiny table: origin -> count, p50, p95, p99, and whether retries were included.
sam: Also request an "exclude retries" toggle for percentile queries (retry_count>0). retries are silently skewing tails across many dashboards.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary/2026-03-22-08 applied to ap-south at 08:18
marta: Another axis: cache_hit. fallback/proxy path had many cache_misses which worsens latency. Include cache_hit in hover breakdown.
lee: Quick repro query to attach to incident: `SELECT percentile(latency_ms,99) AS p99, sample_origin, cache_hit, count(*) FROM telemetry.samples WHERE endpoint='/v1/embeddings' AND time >= '2026-03-22T08:15Z' AND time <= '2026-03-22T08:30Z' GROUP BY sample_origin, cache_hit ORDER BY p99 DESC;`
sam: I'll add an API flag `include_retries=false` by default and extend the percentile response to include origin buckets.
marta: I'll file the incident note and paste a couple of traces. root cause summary: short canary rollout + origin-filtering mismatch between aggregate and endpoint slices + retries. low-risk UI/API fixes planned.
lee: Good. I'll spin up a tiny console PR for the badge + hover and link to the query.
